Location: Darwin NT
Employment Type: Full-time
Hours: 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Salary: AUD $67,510 – $75,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience

About Us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer
The business (ABN 53 603 812 004) is a Darwin-based professional cleaning business servicing commercial, industrial and government clients across the Northern Territory. We provide duct cleaning, air-conditioning cleaning and maintenance, kitchen exhaust cleaning, cool room cleaning, mould remediation, inspection reporting and cleaning schedules.
We are looking for a General Clerk to support our office, administration and customer service functions.

About the Role
The General Clerk will perform general clerical and administrative duties to support daily business operations. The role will assist with customer enquiries, job records, technician paperwork, service reports, filing, data entry and general office support.

The successful applicant will:
- Record, prepare, sort, classify and file customer, supplier and job information.
- Maintain digital and paper records for cleaning, HVAC, duct, mould and maintenance jobs.
- Answer telephone calls, emails and customer enquiries.
- Provide customers with basic information about services, bookings and job documentation.
- Prepare routine documents, job records, service reports and internal summaries.
- Enter customer details, job information and technician notes into business systems.
- Proofread and correct routine emails, forms, reports and service documents.
- Assist with scheduling records, site access paperwork and technician job paperwork.
- Scan, copy, upload and file documents, photos and completion evidence.
- Sort incoming and outgoing mail and office documents.
- Assist with reception duties and general office administration.
- Maintain confidentiality of customer, staff and business records.

Applicants should have:
- Experience in clerical, office administration, reception, customer service or data entry work.
- Good computer skills, including email, Microsoft Office or similar systems.
- Good attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
- Ability to organise records and manage routine paperwork.
- Clear communication skills.
- Ability to work with customers, technicians, suppliers and management.
- Ability to manage several administrative tasks at the same time.

Applicants should have:
- Certificate II or III in Business, Business Administration or a related field; or
- At least 1 year of relevant clerical or administrative experience.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable and organised administration professional who can support our office operations, maintain accurate records, assist with customer enquiries, and help keep our cleaning and maintenance jobs running smoothly.

To apply, submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
- A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.
If you are interested in joining a practical, professional team that delivers specialist HVAC, duct, exhaust, mould and commercial cleaning services across the Northern Territory, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 1 August 2026

Interpreting and decoding vehicle identification numbers (VINs) to identify correct parts specifications

Maintaining detailed records of parts requests and interpretations

Staying current with automotive industry changes, new model releases, and parts nomenclature updates

Key Responsibilities
Establish and maintain secure processes for collecting, storing, processing, and validating data to ensure integrity across all stages of the data lifecycle

Analyse and interpret complex datasets to produce relevant statistics, identify trends and patterns, and provide data-driven answers to business queries
Apply data analytics and visualisation techniques to uncover actionable insights that support operational and strategic goals
Develop clear, compelling reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Write custom scripts and code in languages such as Python, R, or SQL to automate analytical tasks and streamline data workflows
Implement and adhere to data governance frameworks, ensuring all data usage is ethical, compliant, and aligned with organisational policies

Support the continuous improvement of data collection methodologies, reporting tools, and analytical processes across the business
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Demonstrated experience in a data analyst or similar role, with a strong portfolio of analytical work
Proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets
Experience with programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and automation
Solid understanding of statistical methods, data modelling, and analytical best practices
Ability to interpret and communicate complex data findings clearly to diverse audiences
Familiarity with data governance principles, data quality standards, and privacy legislation including the Australian Privacy Act
Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative approach to working across teams
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification or certifications in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related discipline (e.g. Google Data Analytics Certificate, Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate)
Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
Exposure to machine learning concepts or predictive modelling techniques
Experience in an Agile or cross-functional project environment
Industry experience in sectors such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and conference attendance
Contribute to meaningful, high-impact projects that drive real business outcomes across the organisation
Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, wellness initiatives, and career progression pathways
